meta.title: Repoingest - Turn any Git repository into an LLM-friendly digest
meta.description: Replace 'hub' with 'ingest' in any Git URL for a prompt-friendly text digest of the codebase.
home.hero.tagline1: Turn any Git repository into a simple text digest of its codebase.
home.hero.tagline2: This is useful for feeding a codebase into any LLM.
home.how.title: How it works
home.how.step1.title: Paste a repository URL
home.how.step1.desc: Any public Git repo from GitHub, Gitee, GitLab and more.
home.how.step2.title: We generate the digest
home.how.step2.desc: A summary, the file tree and the content, with token estimates.
home.how.step3.title: Use it in your LLM
home.how.step3.desc: Copy or download the result and paste it into ChatGPT, Claude and more.
home.features.title: Features
home.usage.title: Quick start
home.usage.p1: Paste any repository URL and click Ingest.
home.usage.p2: You can also replace 'github.com' with 'repoingest.top' in any GitHub URL.
home.cta2.title: Ready to get started?
app.note: You can also replace 'github.com' with 'repoingest.top' in any GitHub URL.
form.pat.tooltip1: PAT is never stored in the backend
form.pat.tooltip2: Used once for cloning, then discarded from memory
form.pat.tooltip4: Cloned repos are deleted after processing
js.job.gone: This digest is no longer available (expired).
